author: Hotochin
text:
Les_Paul wrote: this is my view of the trade, I'll be grateful for any feedback

Les,

Your above chart is something that I have been having trouble with last
night trying to find PAZ's. Looking for CP and the LQ has helped me a
lot, but the problem is that I don't know what to do when you have
re-traces like your lower PAZ in the chart above. So I see the CP that I
 underlined in red. My question is why the upper line of that PAZ is not
 lower? I would have used the LQ spike that the blue arrow is pointing
at as the upper line of the PAZ instead of the one you picked. Can you
help me understand why? Last night while I was looking at charts I saw
tons of examples like this and it was hard for me to draw the PAZ when
you had large pullbacks like the one in this chart.

Thanks,

H

author: Hotochin
text:
ok Mr. IF. I only have one question for you on your chart. I have been
 trying to learn how to draw PAZ's with LES and agree with your FTR and
CP. But the PAZ eludes me. Why did you draw the PAZ up where you did. I
 would have included all the CP and drew the PAZ as the yellow box. This
 means that there would have been no takeout zone. What am I not seeing?

I hate to do this as I don't want to fill the post with things that are
wrong, but my only guess to how you drew that lower line of the PAZ is
because it seemed to be a swap line in which it either kept price up or
down. As far as capping the CP, that is why I drew the yellow box. Make
sense? What am I missing?

Thanks,

H
